Pick and equip operatives before missions
Operatives have their own weapons and health; losing operatives weakens later missions

Clear rooms carefully; protect hostages
Hostages die if terrorists are alerted: move slowly and take shots from cover

Counter-terrorist missions
Missions in order (RA notes mention missions up to 14, with snipers in mission 13)

Roster
Your operative roster; keep the experienced ones alive
